description: This file defines the interface for the mcumgr image management group, including constants, enums, structures, and function prototypes related to firmware image management, versioning, and state handling in Zephyr OS.

methods.name: img_mgmt_read_info
methods.description: Reads information of an image at a specified slot, including version, hash, and flags.

methods.name: img_mgmt_my_version
methods.description: Retrieves the version of the currently running application.

methods.name: img_mgmt_ver_str
methods.description: Formats an image version into a string.

methods.name: img_mgmt_active_slot
methods.description: Returns the active slot number for a given image.

methods.name: img_mgmt_active_image
methods.description: Returns the current active image number.

methods.name: img_mgmt_slot_in_use
methods.description: Checks if a slot is in use based on MCUboot flags.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_any_pending
methods.description: Checks if any slot is in a pending state.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_flags
methods.description: Returns the state flags for a slot.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_set_pending
methods.description: Sets a slot to pending state, either for test or permanent.

methods.name: img_mgmt_state_confirm
methods.description: Confirms the current image state to prevent fallback.

methods.name: img_mgmt_reset_upload
methods.description: Resets the upload state (requires mutex support).

methods.name: img_mgmt_error_rsp
methods.description: Generates an error response with optional reason string.
